user.title: Connect Pyronix HomeControl
user.description: Enter the privately prepared HomeControl connection details. The integration reads status and requires the Pyronix user code for manual arm/disarm commands.

data_description.connection_details: The setup helper normally submits these details for you. They are stored only in this integration's configuration.

reconfigure.title: Update Pyronix credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the app password and user code currently set for this panel in HomeControl 2.0.

data_description.app_password: The panel's app password, not your HomeControl account password.
data_description.user_code: The 4 to 8 digit code you use at the alarm keypad.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Pyronix
reauth_confirm.description: The panel rejected the saved credentials. Enter the app password and user code currently set for this panel in HomeControl 2.0.

data_description.app_password: The panel's app password, not your HomeControl account password.
data_description.user_code: The 4 to 8 digit code you use at the alarm keypad.

error.invalid_connection: The connection details are incomplete or invalid.

authentication_failed.message: The panel rejected the saved credentials. Complete the re-authentication prompt, then press Connect.

connect_failed.message: Could not connect to the panel: {error}

not_connected.message: Disconnected. Press Connect to read the panel.

command_in_progress.message: Another panel command is in progress; wait for its result.
